title.narrative: Building Resilient Future for Migration-prone Population in Georgia
Building Resilient Future for Migration-prone Population in Georgia

description.narrative: Enhancing migration governance in Georgia by leveraging private sector partnerships and innovative, migration-focused solutions that uphold ethical recruitment and migrant protection, and support climate-resilient and sustainable livelihoods for all groups on the move, fully aligning with the broader goals of fostering socioeconomic inclusion and resilience in the face of migration and environmental challenges.

Förbättra migrationsstyrningen i Georgien genom att utnyttja partnerskap med den privata sektorn och innovativa, migrationsinriktade lösningar som upprätthåller etisk rekrytering och skydd av migranter, samt stödjer klimattåliga och hållbara försörjningsmöjligheter för alla grupper som är på flykt, i full överensstämmelse med de övergripande målen att främja socioekonomisk inkludering och motståndskraft inför migration och miljöutmaningar.

The project objective is to enhance migration governance in Georgia by leveraging private sector partnerships and innovative, migration-focused solutions that uphold ethical recruitment and migrant protection, and support climate-resilient and sustainable livelihoods for all groups on the move, fully aligning with the broader goals of fostering socioeconomic inclusion and resilience in the face of migration and environmental challenges.
The project aims to achieve this objective through three outcomes:
Outcome 1: Georgian migrants-including potential migrants, returnees, and eco-migrants-demonstrate improved skills, leading to enhanced employability and economic integration aligned with labour market demands in Georgia
Outcome 2: Private recruitment agencies and related stakeholders in Georgia demonstrate improved recruitment practices, leading to increased protection of migrants against trafficking risks and exploitation.
Outcome 3: Relevant stakeholders in Georgia (e.g., financial institutions, civil society organizations, the private sector, migrant and their households) advance the enhancement of climate adaptation in a migrant-responsive manner.
The project will enhance the employability and economic integration of Georgian migrants-including potential migrants, returnees, and eco-migrants by providing access to newly developed, certified vocational training programs in high-demand sectors (e.g., IT, agriculture, construction, hospitality, transport, and logistics). Activities include labour market assessments, employer outreach, curriculum upgrades, enabling apprenticeships with private businesses in Georgia , awareness campaigns, job fairs, and orientation sessions. Special emphasis is placed on ensuring inclusion of underrepresented groups, particularly women and youth, in all training and job placement opportunities. These outputs are designed to increase employability, reduce irregular migration, and foster economic empowerment, especially for young people and women.
